josh (PM): Quick sync: prioritize a small, testable Optimize toolkit MVP for Q2. Must cover batching recs, prefix cache suggestions, safe quant profiles, and eval-triggered alerts. Thoughts on scope?
maya (eng): Lean MVP: policy engine + suggest-only UI, sampling-based simulator, and a CLI toggle for pilots. Avoid full console until after pilot.
dylan (ml): For quant, start with one conservative 8-bit profile and one experimental. Eval harness should run A/B on pilot traces and produce per-route quality delta.
nina (cs): Pilot candidates: Lumina (low latency) and DataFoundry (cost-first). Lumina will reject aggressive quant.
trey (sre): Must include runtime fallback paths and circuit-breaker on cache hits. Expose 95/99 latency and fallback counts.
olga (data): I'll prototype a replay simulator that estimates cost and tail latency impact given sampled traces. Feels essential for prescriptive recs.
maya (eng): Rough eng timings: policy + routing 4w, simulator 2w, CLI UX 1w, eval integration 2w -> ~9w. Trim console and we can hit ~6w.
josh (PM): Proposed launch gates: (1) two pilots onboarded, (2) >=8% cost reduction OR <=8% latency regression, (3) eval alerts precision >90% for pilot configs, (4) docs + basic SDK.
dylan (ml): Alert triggers: quality delta >0.02 embedding sim or production feedback drop >0.03 across rolling 100 calls. Make thresholds adjustable per pilot.
nina (cs): I'll coordinate pilot onboarding and collect sample traces for the simulator. Expect manual tuning early.
ci-bot: created follow-up: https://redwood.internal/threads/2201234567-pilot-setup-checklist :white_check_mark:
josh (PM): Thanks — action items: maya draft policy schema, olga prototype replay, dylan add quant evals, nina confirm pilot readiness. Check-in in 6 days.
